text:
alex: Heads-up — reserved a private deploy window for Vanguard (on-prem VPC) this Saturday 2024-05-18 03:00-05:00 UTC. Primary goals: rollout model v2.1, infra tuning, and smoke validation. Need volunteers for runbook steps + rollback readiness.

morgan: I can be primary during the window. I'll handle smoke + logs. Please @sam for the manifest PR and @jenny for KMS/config checks. :thumbsup:

sam: pinged — PR #4823 is ready for review (k8s initContainer + image pin). small change, no schema migrations. tagging reviewers now.

jenny: quick note — customer uses a dedicated KMS key. I checked permissions; we need to add the onprem node identity to the key policy before cutover. I'll post the policy diff shortly.

lin: plan to release as canary first (10% for 15m -> 50% for 20m -> full). If any latency or token errors >5% fail rate, we roll back.

alex: checklist (short):
- backup: DB snapshot + model artifact backup (jenkins job completed?)
- infra: node images pre-pulled
- perms: KMS policy applied
- smoke: health + sample prompts pass
- rollback tested and documented

morgan: DB snapshot job succeeded at 2024-05-17T20:12Z (ID: snapshot-vanguard-20240517). Jenkins log: https://ci.redwood/snapshots/1234

sam: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4823 — reviewers: @lin, @alex. CI green except a flaky lint job (ignored). Will merge after approvals.

jenny: KMS policy diff (apply to customer-kms-vg1):
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/redwood-onprem-node" }, "Action": "kms:Decrypt" }
  ]
}
```
I will push this at T-30m so there is time to validate.

morgan: smoke commands (I'll run these once canary is up):
```bash
# basic health
curl -fsS https://internal.vanguard.local/health | grep -q OK
# sample generation
/opt/redwood/bin/smoke-run --suite vanguard --input ./smoke_prompts.json --timeout 60
```
If any fail, we mark canary unhealthy and trigger rollback.

alex: rollback plan (short):
- revert k8s deployment to image tag `v2.0-stable` (kubectl rollout undo or terraform apply with previous image var)
- restore DB from snapshot if data migration happened (not expected)
- re-enable old routing config (we keep previous endpoints for 30m)

lin: I will coordinate the traffic switch. preparing a short script to cut traffic: `switch-traffic --target canary --percent 10`. will post it in ops channel before T-5m.

sam: merged PR #4823 and rebased main. tag `v2.1-rc` pushed to registry. Image SHA: sha256:abc123...

morgan: on-call checklist:
- I have ssh access to customer jumpbox (tested)
- docker images pre-pulled on nodes: yes
- monitoring alerts copied to our pager on-call: yes

jenny: double-checking secrets: we must ensure the onprem vault mount is accessible. I'll run a read test at T-40m.

alex: minor coordination: please avoid major infra changes in the 6h before window. tag any prep changes with `vanguard-priv` in PR title.

deploy-bot: Slot reservation created: vanguard-priv-1715554321 (window 2024-05-18T03:00:00Z to 2024-05-18T05:00:00Z). Notifying infra oncall.

lin: I'll be available for rollback if needed. also bringing one extra engineer (tara) for logs.

morgan: timeline TL;DR — T-60m: final validation (KMS + secrets + nodes), T-30m: apply KMS policy, T-10m: merge/confirm image, T+0: start canary 10% for 15m, T+15m: assess -> 50% if green, T+35m: full if green.

alex: perfect. if anything blocks, drop updates here. I'll run the post-deploy checklist and capture metrics. Good luck :rocket:
